recipe.visualDefinition: A 3x4 grid featuring twelve identical emoji-style illustrations of pregnant women, each distinguished by unique combinations of skin tones, hair colors, and sweater colors, set against a stark white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Uniformity of pose across all twelve subjects
High-contrast isolation against a void background
Rhythmic repetition of form with color variation

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Twelve subjects of equal scale arranged in a centered 3x4 grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The collective grid formation acts as a singular visual unit.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Scanning from top-left to bottom-right, following the color shifts.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the grid and between individual icons.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Multi-colored sweaters (Pink, Teal, Lime, Red, Navy, Orange, Purple, Blue, Mint, Periwinkle, Yellow, Magenta)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Varied skin tones and hair colors (Black, Brown, Blonde)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in clothing against neutral skin tones and a bright white field.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a clean 3x4 grid of diverse pregnant woman emojis on a solid white background. Ensure each emoji has a different sweater color and skin tone combination.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: No text is required for this composition.

verificationChecks: Ensure grid alignment is perfectly symmetrical

recipe.reuseFormula: Create a [Grid Size] grid of [Subject Type] icons in a [Style Name] style, varying [Attribute 1] and [Attribute 2] while maintaining a constant [Attribute 3] on a [Background Color] background.
